relationships.subject: CGRP inhibitors
relationships.evidence_quote: CGRPi were found to be associated with reduced odds of gabapentinoid prescription after 30 days compared to propranolol

key_findings: In a TriNetX cohort of SCI/D patients, CGRP inhibitors were associated with lower odds of gabapentinoid prescription versus propranolol (OR 0.75) and topiramate (OR 0.62).
Authors suggest CGRPi may be useful for SCI/D-induced neuropathic pain.
